title: Job
description: One run of one procedure version against one asset. This is the ASSEMBLED read model the DataSource seam returns; storage is decomposed into step_outcomes/ and fields/ subcollections so a capture writes O(1) documents instead of rewriting the whole aggregate. See specs/2026-08-20-firestore-design.md section 7.0.

schema_version.description: 1. Absent reads as 1. Sealed evidence is upgraded on read, never migrated in place — see specs/2026-08-20-firestore-design.md section 9.1.

procedure_version.description: The version that ran, not the current one.

status.description: draft is held back from the fleet: NO agent runs on a draft job. finalize() flips draft to open, and that is the human act.

tier.description: What the surface performing this job can actually supply.

finalized_by.description: Who said go. The draft gate is a named act, not a timeout.

step_count.description: Denormalised so a list view needs one read per job and no subcollection fan-out.
